payload.title: Farm Setup and Storage in-page tab strips are split across two console workspaces (Sites and Storage Locations only in Company; Systems, Equipment, Species and stock tabs only in Production), so clicking a tab moves the rail to another workspace and no invariant detects it
evidence: web/modules/farm-module/src/pages/setup/SetupPage.tsx:51-144 (one tab strip: Sites, Departments, Systems, Equipment, Structure, Species, Suppliers, ..., Workers)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/org.ts:93-100 (Sites and Storage Locations are listed only in Company)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/aqua.ts:65-74 (Production lists Systems and Equipment but not Sites)
web/shell/src/console/nav/pages/farmOperations.ts:84-103 (Production's storage strip lacks the locations tab, which is a separate Company entry)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaceForPath.ts:41-63 (the rail moves to the workspace that claims the path most strongly)
tests/invariants/web-console-nav-coverage.spec.ts:16-31 (rules 1-6; none forbids an in-page strip spanning workspaces)
payload.rule_violated: Plan rule 7 (an in-page tab strip never spans workspaces) and the repo hierarchy impossible > automatic > detectable: this drift is neither impossible nor detected.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-27, release R7.
